negatives.name: noncanonical_identity
negatives.reason: y = p + 1 encodes the identity non-canonically; refused as a non-canonical encoding and as small order

negatives.name: invalid_encoding_x0_sign1
negatives.reason: x = 0 with the sign bit set is not a valid point encoding; OpenSSL decodes it as the order-2 point, so a lax verifier accepts this signature

negatives.name: invalid_encoding_x0_sign1_identity
negatives.reason: y = 1 with the sign bit set decodes to the identity under OpenSSL, which verifies R = B, S = 1 for any message

negatives.name: mixed_order_r
negatives.reason: R carries an order-8 component: only the cofactored equation holds, the cofactorless one does not

negatives.name: noncanonical_s
negatives.reason: S is not reduced modulo the group order
